0022600207.text: The Mavericks host the Pacers in their 11th game of the 2026-27 season, with Dallas (6-4, 4-2 at home) on a two-game win streak and sitting 10th in the West, 2 games back in the Southwest. Indiana (3-7, 0-5 at home) has lost its last game and is 11th in the East, 3.5 games back in the Central. Dallas leads the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after its 121-105 win in Indianapolis, and the Mavericks won the 2025-26 series 2-0. Dallas is missing Dereck Lively II (foot, surgery), Sergio de Larrea (knee strain), and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation), while Indiana is without Ben Sheppard (knee), Johnny Furphy (knee, surgery), and Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring strain), and T.J. McConnell is day-to-day with a hamstring strain and a game-time decision.
